title.en: Common Program of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (29 September 1949)

description.ko: 중화인민공화국 선포 직전 정치협상회의가 채택해 1954년 헌법까지 임시 헌법 구실을 한 강령. 신민주주의를 국가의 정치적 기초로 선언하고, 국영·합작사·개체·사적 자본주의·국가자본주의의 다섯 경제 성분을 국영 경제의 영도 아래 두었다.
description.en: The program adopted by the Political Consultative Conference on the eve of the founding of the People's Republic, serving as interim constitution until 1954. It declares New Democracy the political foundation of the state and places five economic sectors (state, cooperative, individual, private capitalist and state capitalist) under the leadership of the state sector.

source: 中國人民政治協商會議共同綱領, adopted 29 September 1949 by the First Plenary Session of the CPPCC, Beiping; Renmin Ribao, 30 September 1949. Text: 中央人民政府法令彙編（一九四九—一九五〇）, pp. 44–53, as transcribed on Chinese Wikisource, https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/中國人民政治協商會議共同綱領 (accessed 2026-10-07).
